purpose.statement: Catalog one hundred new PortableDoc block candidates, rank them by demonstrated usefulness, and file the S-tier build backlog.
purpose.why: The larger PortableDoc evolution goal needs new primitives selected by reader demand rather than novelty. candidate ideas were scattered and their cross-reader feasibility, duplication, and actual use cases were unknown. Running a fixed inventory, review rubric, reader-gap repairs, and ranked handoff was the right intervention because a common corpus lets usefulness and implementation cost be compared before committing to schema growth. If omitted, the format accumulates niche blocks while common reader failures and valuable primitives remain unprioritized.
